task: Built a complete voice interface for askr with local Whisper STT, wake-word detection, automatic user-specific calibration, live Terminal window with status display, and end-to-end delivery of spoken requests to Claude Code sessions.
discussion_summary: The project fixed three critical issues blocking the user: random session kills (PreCompact hook was killing sessions during compaction), terminal windows opening unexpectedly (test harness was spawning real Terminal.app), and lack of voice support. Voice stages 1–7 are now complete: mic listener with adaptive noise floor, local Whisper transcription, fuzzy wake-word matching with per-user calibration, session digest and talker agent, delivery via terminal typing (primary) and Stop-hook inbox (fallback), live narration of responses, and a dedicated Terminal.app window with pinned status line showing listening state, mic level meter, and live partial transcription. All 746 tests pass. The user's feedback that the wake word wasn't heard and nothing was visible led directly to stages 6–7 (Terminal window, status display, calibration guards).

accomplishments.what: Stage 1: MicListener with adaptive energy segmenter, 600ms pre-roll, and Whisper STT with initial_prompt tuning
Stage 2: Talker agent with session digest, intent classification (instruction/question/clarify/chat), and Haiku 4.5 response generation
Stage 3: Delivery via Cursor extension terminal typing (primary) and Stop-hook inbox fallback
Stage 4: Narrator that streams session responses back as spoken audio via macOS say with voice lock
Stage 5: askr voice CLI command with profile loading and inline/window modes
Stage 6: Own Terminal.app window with pinned status line (listening/hearing/transcribing/thinking/speaking/sending), mic level meter with threshold marker, and live partial transcription
Stage 7: Fuzzy wake-word matching (one edit distance, filler skipping, exclusion of asked/asks) and automatic calibration on first launch learning user's Whisper spelling and speech floor
Calibration guards: rejects sentences, non-askr samples, background audio; requires ≥3 clean samples; deleted bogus profile from smoke test
Fixed PreCompact hook to observe-only (no kills); removed idle-session kill; removed mid-turn kill
Fixed test harness spawning real Terminal windows; added conftest sweep of uppercase config constants to tmp_path
Verified all 746 tests pass after voice subsystem completion

decisions.decision: Use local Whisper base.en int8 with initial_prompt 'Askr, run the tests.' for STT
decisions.reason: Measured best accuracy on user's voice; avoids cloud latency and privacy concerns

decisions.decision: Fuzzy wake-word matching: one edit distance from asker/askr, after filler skipping (hey/ok/so/um/uh/etc.), excluding asked/asks/aster/ashes/asset
decisions.reason: Fixed spelling list tuned on say(1) voice missed user's pronunciation; fuzzy matching + per-user calibration learns actual Whisper output

decisions.decision: Automatic calibration on first launch: user says 'askr' 5 times, learns Whisper's spelling and sets speech floor from user's volume
decisions.reason: Eliminates fixed thresholds that don't adapt to user's mic, room, and voice; guards prevent background audio contamination

decisions.decision: Calibration only counts askr-like single words; rejects sentences, common words (you, the, asked, okay, hello, banana, a), and non-learnable spellings
decisions.reason: Smoke test accidentally learned 'you' from YouTube audio; guards prevent similar contamination

decisions.decision: Calibration requires ≥3 clean samples before saving profile; otherwise prints hint about mic permissions
decisions.reason: Prevents saving incomplete or noisy profiles; user can retry if needed

decisions.decision: askr voice opens own Terminal.app window (--here flag runs inline instead)
decisions.reason: User feedback: no visibility into listening state; own window eliminates ambiguity about which terminal to use

decisions.decision: Pinned status line shows state (listening/hearing/transcribing/thinking/speaking/sending) with live mic level meter and threshold marker
decisions.reason: User feedback: no indication of listening or transcription; visual feedback confirms the system is working

decisions.decision: Every heard line printed including ignored ones with reason (e.g. 'no wake word, ignored')
decisions.reason: Debugging: user can see exactly what Whisper heard and why it was rejected

decisions.decision: PreCompact hook is observe-only; no kills, no checkpoints, only logging
decisions.reason: Kills were firing on wrong sessions (cwd-based PID guess), killing idle sessions, and killing mid-turn sessions; logging is sufficient for diagnostics

decisions.decision: Delivery via Cursor extension terminal typing (primary) and Stop-hook inbox fallback
decisions.reason: PostToolUse additionalContext is refused as prompt injection; terminal typing is reliable; inbox handles mid-turn fallback

decisions.decision: Talker enforces intent field and send/say rules: instruction always sent, say <30 words, never second-guess off-topic instructions
decisions.reason: Early runs withheld off-topic instructions; enforcement ensures consistent behavior

decisions.decision: Use Haiku 4.5 for talker (not haiku-5-5 or sonnet models which return 429 over OAuth token)
decisions.reason: Measured: haiku-4-5 works; haiku-5-5 and sonnet-5-5/4-6 return 429 over OAuth transport
